title: console form: a { group } section warns that it "also declares collapsible, collapsed" on every parse, because the spec fills both as false and the renderer checks !== undefined
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**, class (c) inverted: the console's prescription tells an author to rewrite metadata that is already correct. Moved from objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2293, whose HotCRM-side premise did not hold (readings below).

## What happens

Opening any HotCRM contact or opportunity record logs, once per page:

```
[object-ui] form section { group: 'buying_centre' } also declares `collapsible`, `collapsed` — the group owns those keys and the authored value is ignored. `@objectstack/spec` refuses this combination at parse (there are no override semantics); set it on the object's `fieldGroups` entry for the group instead.
```

and the same for `{ group: 'qualification' }`. HotCRM authors neither key on those sections: `src/sales/views/contact.view.ts` writes `{ group: 'buying_centre', columns: 2 }` and `src/sales/views/opportunity.view.ts` writes `{ group: 'qualification', columns: 2 }` (hotcrm `main` `42c34c9`; `git grep -n "collapsible\|collapsed"` over `src/**/*.page.ts` and `src/**/*.view.ts` finds only comments, while the same grep finds `collapse: 'collapsed'` on `contact.object.ts:21`, so the instrument reaches those files).

## Why (read on objectstack `origin/main` `2a728ba2ac`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the form section's `collapsible` and `collapsed` are `z.boolean().default(false)`, and the group refinement lists them under `trueOnlyDerivedKeys` — only `true` is refused beside `group`; `false` is accepted because it declares what the group already delivers. A parsed section therefore always carries `collapsible: false, collapsed: false`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionGroups.ts` `reportGroupOwnedKeys`: `GROUP_OWNED_SECTION_KEYS.filter((k) => section[k] !== undefined)` includes `collapsible` and `collapsed`, so the parse-filled `false` defaults trip the warning on every group section of a parsed form. The renderer and the spec disagree on what "declares" means.

## Business reason

Who is hurt: every AI author or developer reading the console on a correct app. The warning names a fix ("set it on the object's `fieldGroups`") for a mistake nobody made, and it was followed once already: a 2026-10-25 browser pass filed objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2293 asking HotCRM to move keys it never wrote. A warning that fires on correct metadata also hides the real case it exists for (a programmatic caller sending `true`).

## Landing and reader

- Reader: the `domain:ui` seat, at first touch after triage.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionGroups.ts`: treat `collapsible` / `collapsed` as true-only owned keys, matching the spec's `trueOnlyDerivedKeys` (warn on `true`, ignore `false` / absent). A test beside it: a parsed `{ group, columns }` section produces no warning; `{ group, collapsed: true }` from a programmatic caller still does.

## Done when

No group-owned-key warning on HotCRM contact and opportunity pages on a console built from the fix; the `true` case still warns.

Dedupe: REST list of objectstack issues (open, newest 300; closed, newest 240) grepped locally for `group owns`, `sectionGroups`, `GROUP_OWNED`, `also declares \`collapsible\`` → 0 hits; control: the same corpus finds the seven 2026-10-25 browser-pass cards (#25873–#25884). `reach:` the public UI, every contact / opportunity record page.

Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat, `os-project-manager`, session `session_016AYFEQGMzwZqJxBYr2AKWr`.
